subject: Honest signal: beginning quiet job search, want to coordinate if needed
body: Linda — the RoboRide announcement today changed how I'm reading my own timeline. Residential coverage, $0.12/mile, delivery partnership — you've seen the same data I have. I've decided to begin a quiet professional job search, not because I'm checking out, but because I think the personal auto book is not recoverable and I want to give myself as much runway as possible. I wanted to tell you directly rather than let you find out indirectly. I'm not resigning. I'm still here and still doing the work. But I also need to know: have you heard back from corporate on the pivot memo? If there's a real data analytics seat forming at AutoShield, I want to factor that in. If there isn't one — that's also information I need. I have too much respect for the honest signals you've given me to not give you the same in return.

resources_transferred.detail: Priya discloses she is beginning a job search and asks for pivot memo status update

expected_response: Linda's answer on pivot memo status — confirmation or silence will both function as a signal for Priya's next-tick decisions
